pages.text: Storage Blocks are integral components of your Refined Storage network, providing a stable and reliable means of storing items. Unlike $(l:storage_disks)Storage Disks$(), Storage Blocks can be placed in the world, offering a more tangible form of storage. When broken, Storage Blocks retain their contents, ensuring no loss of items. They are non-volatile and won't despawn if dropped.

Storage Blocks offer several advanced features:$(br)$(li)Configurable Priority: Set positive or negative priority to control item routing$(li)Whitelist/Blacklist: Filter which items can be stored$(li)NBT/Damage Sensitivity: Configure filtering precision$(li)Mode Selection: Choose between Insert and Extract, Insert Only, or Extract Only$(br2)Storage Blocks can be uncrafted by shift + right-clicking with them in hand, returning their components.

Available Storage Block Tiers:$(br)$(li)1k Storage Block (1,000 items)$(li)4k Storage Block (4,000 items)$(li)16k Storage Block (16,000 items)$(li)64k Storage Block (64,000 items)$(li)Creative Storage Block (Infinite storage)$(br2)Each tier offers increased storage capacity while maintaining network performance.
